meta.name: EXECUTED - DO NOT REIMPORT - NARA v4 liquidity-stack recovery proposal
meta.description: HISTORICAL EXECUTED STAGE-0 PAYLOAD. Human Safe signers executed this exact no-movement keeper-revocation and WindDown proposal on 2026-07-31. Reimporting it would restart the delay.

simulation.scope: Pre-execution builder simulation only. The execution object above records the later external human Safe transaction.
simulation.method: Pinned eth_call/staticCall for each independent call
simulation.diagnosticFullDecreaseRule: Full DECREASE_LIQUIDITY + TAKE + TAKE calls were simulated independently from each current NFT owner. They are not transactions in this batch.
simulation.compounderDecreaseCaveat: The compounder-owner eth_call proves the PositionManager authorization/accounting path only. The NFT must first reach the Safe through WindDown before a real Safe decrease can be prepared.

poolSpot.warning: Spot conversion is an estimate, not guaranteed proceeds. It excludes hook/swap fees, slippage, price impact, and future state changes.

positions.liquidityScope: poolActiveLiquidity is total in-range pool liquidity; namedProtocolActiveLiquidity is only the two identified full-range protocol positions.

withdrawalInventorySnapshot.scope: Both LP principals, currently collectable LP fees, vault balances, and compounder-banked balances at the pinned snapshot block.

lpCollectableFees.determination: Calculated from pinned PoolManager feeGrowthInside minus each salted position's last fee growth, multiplied by position liquidity / 2^128.

totalActualTokensAcrossScope.separationRule: The USDC figure is actual USDC. NARA remains NARA and is not assumed sold.

spotValuationEstimate.warning: This marks NARA at the instantaneous pool spot only. A real NARA sale would move this shallow market and incur hook/swap fees, so realizable USDC can be materially lower.

withdrawalInventorySnapshot.timing: Amounts are exact raw-token accounting at the snapshot but remain time-sensitive until liquidity is actually decreased and fees collected.

recovery.projectionRule: Projection uses snapshot block time. The authoritative ETA is pendingRecovery.eta emitted when the Safe executes this proposal.

replacementRecoveryPolicy.oldStackRule: The active old compounder's immutable seven-day delay is unchanged by this proposal.
replacementRecoveryPolicy.scopeCorrection: The user requires a genuinely new V5 token, engine, reserve and complete protocol stack, not a same-token liquidity-periphery replacement.
replacementRecoveryPolicy.rehearsalRule: Use a disposable non-public V5 full-stack rehearsal with a one-hour recovery delay only to prove complete recovery and retirement behavior.
replacementRecoveryPolicy.productionRule: After rehearsal succeeds, deploy a fresh complete V5 production stack with a recovery delay of at least seven days and permanently seal it before public activation. New token supply, holder treatment, allocations and V5 liquidity require explicit separate approval.
replacementRecoveryPolicy.safetyInvariant: Do not make the production delay decreaseable. Any supported delay transition must be one-way non-decreasing, and sealing must be irreversible.

operatorWarnings: HISTORICAL EXECUTED PAYLOAD: DO NOT REIMPORT, RESIGN, SUBMIT, OR REPROPOSE. Re-proposal restarts the seven-day delay.
The generator itself only read Base and simulated with eth_call; the later external human Safe execution is recorded in the execution object and separate evidence file.

Do not regenerate this executed Stage-0 artifact. Build a different fresh one-block withdrawal artifact after maturity and abort if any ownership, binding, keeper, NFT, liquidity, or pending-recovery evidence changes.
This batch does not remove liquidity. It leaves both LP NFTs and both liquidity positions in place while the seven-day clock runs.
The inventory is a pinned snapshot, not a guaranteed withdrawal receipt. Recompute it immediately before any later decrease-liquidity batch.
Actual USDC and NARA are listed separately. The USDC-equivalent total is only a no-swap spot mark and must not be described as guaranteed USDC proceeds.
Use the on-chain pendingRecovery.eta after execution; the projected ETA in this file is not execution authority.
A later executeRecovery transfers only the compounder-owned LP NFT and banked NARA/USDC to the Safe; it does not burn that NFT or decrease its liquidity.
The seed LP NFT is already Safe-owned and is untouched by this recovery proposal; any eventual liquidity decrease requires a separately reviewed PositionManager plan.
Revoking the dedicated keeper stops that keeper only. The Safe retains vault owner authority and hook fees may continue to accrue.
The separate one-hour replacement rehearsal policy does not alter this old compounder's immutable seven-day recovery clock and adds no call to this batch.
